subject: general
question: How many such pairs of letters are there in the word INTERNATIONAL (in both forward and backward directions) which have as many letters between them in the word as there are in the English alphabetical order?
solution:
**Given: **INTERNATIONAL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/96291a8b1de2db52fcfb74bccf5293b6f4b8b1050b0ebc66086a0b732fafb0ce.png] 

**Solution: **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/392b999d88259a4e38e8ddf1c67ee189238ee8b6322230554e6787406aebdf01.png] **

Forward Pair - IN, NT

Backward Pair - LN, LO, NO, RT

Hence, **six** such pair of which has as many letters between them in the word as they have between them in the English alphabetical series.

**Hence, 'option 4' is correct.**
